decisions.rationale: pull_request runs use the PR's own workflow YAML, so the routing expression and in-job guard are not an enforcement boundary against forks. Enforcement moved into the runner image: an ACTIONS_RUNNER_HOOK_JOB_STARTED hook refuses every event except push to main, workflow_dispatch and same-repo pull_request, judged from the GitHub-written payload; spec scenarios, tests (3.6), O11 negative test added. Same-repo PRs remain routable (trust scope of A10); the reviewer's 'push/dispatch only' baseline was not adopted because the hook closes the fork path without giving up same-repo PR routing.
nftables rules must be persistent (/etc/nftables.conf + nftables.service); O10 re-verifies isolation after reboot.
